core_obligations: Reduce to the presheaf level: since f_!F is the sheafification of f_{p!}F, it suffices to construct a map of presheaves f_{p!}F tensor_{p,Lambda} G to f_{p!}(F tensor_Lambda f^{-1}G) (proof lines 2041-2053).

Define the map: on pure tensors by (Z, s) tensor t maps to (Z, s tensor f^{-1}t), well-formed because the support of s tensor f^{-1}t stays inside Z; extend by linearity; note the compatibility with the colimit transition maps and with restrictions is immediate from the displayed rule (proof lines 2054-2082).

Conclude the isomorphism: sheafify, form the stalk diagram at a geometric point over y, identify the vertical arrows with the stalk lemma, note the lower horizontal arrow is the obvious isomorphism of the fibre direct sums, and conclude can is an isomorphism (proof lines 2082-2102).
